name: loihi
display_name: Intel Loihi 1 (14 nm, Davies 2018), 128 cores, dense equivalent 128 x 1024

faithfulness.note: The per-core capacity of Loihi is a synaptic memory (128 KB) with fan-in and fan-out list limits (davies2018loihi p89). The registered geometry is its dense equivalent until a memory-bound core type exists (CH-B2).

notes: allow_coalescing is false: "Each neuromorphic core implements 1,024 primitive spiking neural units (compartments) grouped into sets of trees constituting neurons" (davies2018loihi p.86, the registered geometry's provenance), so a neuron integrates within its core and no inter-core partial sum exists; a wide fan-in the dense equivalent's 128 axons cannot hold is the approximation's, and a deployment that needs one declares coalescing through target_overrides with a note, which its faithfulness names. allow_neuron_splitting is true: "The total number of core-to-core fan-out edges mapped to any given core must not exceed 4,096 (Naxout)" (p.89), so an axon reaches neurons on several cores, the input sharing a split core needs.

stated.quote: Each neuromorphic core implements 1,024 primitive spiking neural units (compartments) grouped into sets of trees constituting neurons.

unstated.note: The source states any weight precision between one and nine bits, signed or unsigned ('Variable synaptic formats', p.84); the dense-equivalent geometry declares 8-bit weights (128 KB of synaptic memory over 1,024 neurons), the description's assumption.

stated.quote: The synaptic response current is the sum of filtered input spike trains and a constant bias current:
stated.note: Each compartment adds its constant bias b_i (Eq. (1)). The registered dense-equivalent geometry declared bias rows (an extraction-card default); the geometry now states the on-chip bias (imc_platforms_literature, U-CHIPKEYS).

stated.quote: We adopt a variation of the well-known CUBA leaky-integrate-and-fire model that has two internal state variables: the synaptic response current ui(t) and the membrane potential vi(t).
stated.note: The current and membrane decays are per-compartment parameters; a deployment sets them for the toolchain's integrate-and-fire law.

unstated.note: Loihi advances every neuron in fixed-size, synchronized algorithmic time-steps with barrier synchronization (p.83-85); a spike of time-step t reaches its targets for t + 1. Both of the toolchain's LIF variants schedule onto that; the deployment declares one.
The source states no window; the deployment declares it.
The source states no level count; the deployment declares it.
